scripts.preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build && npm run clean:dot && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run clean:dot && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run clean:dot && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrate:preview: npm run clean:dot && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env=preview
scripts.deps:lock: npx -y npm@10.9.2 install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run check:lock
scripts.preview:e2e: opennextjs-cloudflare build && npm run clean:dot && rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && CI=true npm run db:migrate:e2e && ([ -f .dev.vars ] || cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars) && opennextjs-cloudflare preview --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state
scripts.test:e2e:prod: bash scripts/e2e-deployed.sh prod --no-deps routing.spec.ts design-system.spec.ts admin-auth.spec.ts gallery-public.spec.ts site-frame.spec.ts motion.spec.ts -g "ohne Anmeldung|gefälscht|Clickjacking|Robust|Deutsch|Englisch|Spracherkennung|Nicht lokalisierte|Tokens|Schriften|unbekannte Galerie|Rahmen|Bewegung"
